endorsements.name: Prasenjit Kanti Paul
endorsements.label: CVE-2019-1866
endorsements.description: Cisco Webex Business Suite before 39.1.0 contains a vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to affect the integrity of the application. The vulnerability is due to improper validation of host header values. An attacker with a privileged network position, either a man-in-the-middle or by intercepting wireless network traffic, could exploit this vulnerability to manipulate header values sent by a client to the affected application. The attacker could cause the application to use input from the header to redirect a user from the Cisco Webex Meetings Online site to an arbitrary site of the attacker's choosing.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: LOW (CVSS 3.1, 3.1)
